description: This file implements the native CPU functions for the EmbeddingBag operation in PyTorch. It includes functions for forward and backward passes, argument validation, and utilities for handling offsets, bag sizes, maximum indices, and various modes such as sum, mean, and max. It heavily utilizes templates for support of different data types and manages complex operations like efficient index selection, scaling, and aggregation for embedding lookups.
